observations.description: Wide shot of a football match showing a goal being scored by the team in red jerseys. The scoreboard reads OSA 1 - CEL 1 at 45:08. A player in red celebrates with arms outstretched near the goal.

Cut to a wide view of the pitch with the score now OSA 2 - CEL 1 at 61:12. Players in light blue pass the ball in midfield. A foul occurs, and the referee shows a yellow card to a player in light blue. Players from both teams gather around the referee.

The scene cuts to a restart at the center circle with the score still 2-1 at 65:19. The team in light blue kicks off and passes the ball backwards. Play continues in the midfield with players moving into position.

Close-up shots of players arguing with the referee after the yellow card incident. A player in light blue with a beard gestures while talking to the referee. Another player in red is also visible nearby.

uncertainties: Exact identity of players due to resolution and distance.
Specific dialogue during arguments with the referee is inaudible.
Precise trajectory of the ball during the corner kick header is partially obscured by players.
